newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes little changed in thin trade.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev ended around 1,602-1,607 per dollar, little changed from the opening 1,600-1,605 after thin interbank trade, dealers said.

"There was not much willingness to trade today. Most of the clients who sold dollars in the previous days to improve lev liquidity have already withdrawn from the market," a commercial bank dealer said.
Banks and clients sold dollars in the past few days ahead of end-month and end-quarter salary and tax payments.
The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) was seen buying foreign currency amid low dollar demand from final clients, dealers said.
Finance Minister Svetoslav Gavriiski said on Wednesday BNB foreign exchange reserves rose by around $100 million last month from $445.5 million at the end of February.

The standby agreement with the IMF projects foreign exchange reserves at $700 million in June, when the new government is expected to introduce a currency board fixed exchange rate system to stabilise the lev.
The International Monetary Fund sealed the $510 million 14-month standby funding arrangement last month with the caretaker government in power until after general elections on April 19.
